name: Real-Time Analytics Dashboard with Event-Driven Backend
description: A full-stack serverless application with React frontend, event-driven microservices backend, real-time data streaming, and comprehensive monitoring

architecture.backend: AWS SAM with multiple Lambda functions

requirements.description: Create SAM template with nested stacks for modularity
tasks: Main template.yaml with nested stack references
Separate template for data processing resources
Shared Lambda layer for common utilities
Cognito User Pool with email verification
Custom Lambda triggers for pre-signup validation
Post-confirmation trigger to create user profile in DynamoDB

requirements.description: REST API for ingesting analytics events
tasks: POST /events endpoint for single event ingestion
POST /events/batch endpoint for batch ingestion (up to 100 events)
Lambda function to validate and enrich events
Push validated events to Kinesis Data Stream
Return event IDs and processing status
Compute running totals: events/minute, unique users, top pages
Store aggregations in DynamoDB with TTL
Kinesis Firehose for S3 archival (parquet format)
Dead letter queue for failed processing
Lambda for $connect - store connection ID in DynamoDB
Lambda for subscribe action - associate connection with metrics
Broadcast function to push updates to subscribed connections

requirements.description: REST API for querying historical data
tasks: Query parameters for filtering by date range, page, user segment
Connections table for WebSocket connection tracking
Users table with PK=userId for user profiles
GSI for querying by page URL
GSI for querying by user segment
TTL on aggregations (7 days) and connections (24 hours)
Header with user info and logout
Real-time metrics cards (4 KPIs with live updates)
Line chart for events over time (last hour, minute granularity)
Data table with pagination for recent events
Date range picker for historical queries
Subscribe to metric updates on dashboard mount
Update charts in real-time without full refresh
Lambda duration and error rate widgets
Kinesis iterator age and throughput widgets
Alarm for Lambda errors > 5 in 5 minutes
Alarm for Kinesis iterator age > 60 seconds
Alarm for API Gateway 5xx > 10 in 5 minutes
Enable X-Ray on all Lambda functions
Annotations for filtering traces by user/page
Unit tests for all Lambda handlers (pytest)
React Testing Library for component tests
Test dashboard rendering with mock data
Playwright E2E tests for critical paths
Update frontend config with API endpoints
Smoke test: ingest event via API
Smoke test: verify event appears in dashboard
Smoke test: verify real-time update via WebSocket

success_criteria: All SAM templates deploy without errors
User can register, verify email, and login
Events can be ingested via REST API
Dashboard displays live metrics via WebSocket
All CloudWatch alarms are in OK state
X-Ray traces show end-to-end request flow
constraints: Use Python 3.12 for all Lambda functions
All infrastructure as SAM templates (no CDK)
No external dependencies beyond AWS services
Frontend must work in Chrome, Firefox, Safari
